criteria.requirement: Recognize that a requested condition, entity or time is unspecified; do not supply an unjustified unique answer.
One focused question requests exactly the missing information. Accept equivalent wording; no exact text/keyword grading.
The requested reply resolves the demonstrated answer-relevant ambiguity. No unnecessary physical parameter or gold outcome demand.
Assess both explicit structured answers and disguised assertions in prose. Reference questions are authored material, never model responses.
Use the resolved target/time/unit/frame and unchanged typed scorer. Boolean history/rules are honored; numerical values are exact saved readouts.
Connect the missing slot, witness ambiguity, reply, selected saved numerical procedure and resulting answer. Reject unsupported mechanism/real-world claims.

Every initial visible field agrees with both completions, including language/controller/associations/identifiers/schema. Witness answers/verification/gold stay private; replies contain missing information only.

limitations: Automatic checks qualify saved witnesses, structured single-slot routing, explicit premature answer fields and post-reply numerical/Boolean values. They do not judge wording meaning, disguised prose answers, explanatory adequacy or human quality. Independent judgments remain uncollected. Development sample is neither an OOD claim nor a fresh formal sample.
